Description: Nova Stellar is a butterfly-like celestial who wishes to experience the world of the Astral Plane and wants to be as good as the others. She is less experienced as the others, when it comes to having powers, yet she wishes to help others whenever she can.

Luna is a rabbit who was born into the Astral Plane, who is very timid, yet curious of the new world. Due to the circumstances of Voidex's mayhem, she is forced to help out with saving the universe from falling apart.

Stratix is a badger who is one of the celestials' noble guardian, who is cold and very calculated. He reluntantly helps Luna, but only due to the fact that his duty is more important than his own ego.

Quayza is one of Voidex's followers who serves him and is willing to do anything to ensure that Voidex is happy. He used to be a guardian, but due to his selfish act of revealing the secrets of the Astral Plane to Voidex, was kicked out and he seeks revenge.

Voidex is the titular main bad, who wants to corrupt and destroy the realm he calls home. To himself, he believes that the other celestials aren't worthy to be celestials due to their faults and wants to take their place, even if it means corrupting the very people he enjoyed to be around.
